# truenas_static_route (Data Source)

Looks up exactly one existing `staticroute` object by `id` or `query_filters`. Secrets are not exposed.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (Number) Identifier of the object to read.
- `query_filters` (String) Middleware query filters as JSON, e.g. `jsonencode([["path", "=", "/mnt/tank/x"]])`. Must match exactly one object.

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) Optional description for this static route. Defaults to `""`.
- `destination` (String) Destination network or host for this static route.
- `gateway` (String) Gateway IP address for this static route.
